name: temporal_guard_v1_02s
description: Leakage guard (independent review, 2026-11-14): EVERY decision-time feature, static positions/pressure/structure and temporal history, is computed 0.2 s BEFORE the release frame, so no frame near the kick can enter it (on SkillCorner the ball is already leaving the foot at the event start frame in ~32% of passes). It also guards C20/C28 (Adt -> Bdt). For SkillCorner the 0.2 s guard is the primary RQ2 analysis.
